resolvedFindings: Rapid first-success/latest-failure left durable and in-memory values inconsistent. Successful serialized writes now apply in order; latest failure preserves the last successful appearance and module-reopen hydration matches.

Hydration beginning after explicit choice could race with its pending persistence. Hydration now skips after any explicit choice begins; existing generation check rejects a hydration started before a newer choice.
verified: Choices remain system/light/dark and device-local only. No Account/cloud/session state or token source is added.
RN installed Appearance.js explicitly treats unspecified as system appearance; system mapping matches this API.
Invalid stored values are ignored, invalid caller values do not write, write failure leaves current successful state and later choices remain usable.

peopleFollowup.changes: useState captures original draft without render ref reads; uppercase error enum and mount-only scope explanation preserve Account/generation/draft-port fences.

limitations: SecureStore and Appearance are mocked in tests; no device/Host/network/real Keychain access.
No normal Settings wiring or Native persistence E2E accepted.
